actions_taken: Removed hardcoded mock admin credentials (admin@fabbi.vn / admin123) from app/login/page.tsx
Removed client-set mock_admin cookie bypass from middleware.ts
Removed mock_admin cookie cleanup from signout route
Removed dev hint '(Dev: admin@fabbi.vn / admin123)' from login page UI

description: Mock admin bypasses are a CRITICAL security finding that must be removed from production auth paths. A client-set cookie (mock_admin=true) that can bypass Supabase Auth and grant admin access via middleware is a direct privilege escalation vulnerability.
action: Removed all mock admin bypass logic from production auth path

description: Middleware and server-side auth guards must be consistent — a client-set cookie should NEVER be trusted for auth. The mock_admin cookie was set by client-side JavaScript and trusted by middleware, creating an unauthenticated bypass path to /admin.
action: Removed client-set cookie from middleware auth check; all auth now flows through Supabase server-side validation

description: Build warning: placeholder Supabase credentials still produce a warning on static page generation. This is expected since USE_MOCK_DATA is false but credentials are placeholder. Non-blocking for phase 02 completion — credentials are env-managed.
action: No immediate action needed; credentials are placeholder-only in repo and real values are injected via env vars at runtime

description: The pattern of client-set cookies for auth bypass should never be used. Auth tokens and session state must be server-set (e.g., httpOnly, server-generated) to prevent privilege escalation via manipulated client state.
rule: Never set auth cookies from client-side JavaScript; use server-side session management via Supabase Auth or equivalent
